citations.excerpt:
The tournament is designed to progress from an opening
pool stage into knockout finals, with the final played in Auckland.

answers.note: This statement explicitly describes that the tournament contains at least 'pool stage' and 'knockout finals' as constituent stages.

citations.excerpt: Pool A | New Zealand | Fiji | Japan | Samoa

answers.note: The listing implies group membership within an overarching event (a pool in a tournament), not direct team-to-team, team-to-stage, or similar relationships.

citations.excerpt: Pool B | Australia | Argentina | South Africa | Tonga

answers.note: The language provides a grouping, implying connection via a tournament or competition structure.

citations.excerpt: Eden Park | Auckland, New Zealand | Opening match and final

answers.note: The phrase 'opening match and final' points to matches (events) rather than a direct relationship between the venue and a stage or outcome; the matches themselves must connect the venue.

citations.excerpt: Sky Stadium | Wellington, New Zealand | Pool and quarter-final matches

answers.note: Assignment of Sky Stadium to 'pool and quarter-final matches' refers to unspecified matches, not to a direct relationship to those stages themselves.

citations.excerpt: Orangetheory Stadium | Christchurch, New Zealand | Quarter-final and semi-final matches

answers.note: Orangetheory Stadium is linked to matches (which define the events), not the broader competition stages directly.

citations.excerpt: Pool A | New Zealand v Fiji | Eden Park

answers.note: The fixture listing (stage, match, venue) does not directly connect teams to stages or venues except through the match itself.

citations.excerpt: Pool A | Japan v Samoa | Sky Stadium

answers.note: As with the prior fixture, the described relationship is realized only via the match, not as a direct tie between team/stage/venue.
